protocol.name: cupertino_screenshot_v1

description.summary: the windows the screenshot process can pick

protocol.description: The capture itself goes through the standard ext-image-capture-source-v1 and ext-image-copy-capture-v1 protocols. What no standard protocol carries is where the windows are drawn, which the screenshot process needs to highlight the window under the pointer and to capture it through its foreign toplevel handle. The protocol is unstable until phase 1 of ends: interfaces may change without a version bump until then.

interface.name: cupertino_screenshot_v1
interface.description: Global singleton, offered only to the shell processes the server started on a connection of their own. Right after binding, and again whenever the set of windows on screen, their order or a frame changes, the server sends one window event per top-level window drawn on an output, front to back, followed by done. Each group replaces the previous one.

event.name: window
event.description: The identifier is the window's ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 identifier. The rectangle is the window frame with its server-side decorations and without its shadow, in global logical coordinates: the area a capture of the toplevel covers.

description.summary: end of a group of window events
